page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening). Running head "ΥΠ" at top centre; page number 463 at top right. Main text in one column of Greek-keyed Latin lexicon entries with Greek words and Latin glosses. Left margin holds a column of marginal notes (partly cut off by the binding, largely illegible).

main_text.p: "Ὑπανδρῶ ὦ viro subjecta, q.d. ἡ ὑπ᾽ ἀνδρα, scil. ἔσα, qua est in potestate viri. Sic ὑπῆς ἐπιταξότας ἐσι, Gal.4.2.
᾿Υπανίζω ὦ occurro. Fut. ἡσω. P. ὑπηλύτης. a.1. act. ὑπηλύτησα.
᾿Υπάρχω sum. τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, qua quis habet, imperf. ὑπῆρχον ες ε, Actor.16.3. Fut. ὑπάρξω. P. ὑπῆρχα. a.1. act. ὑπῆρξα.
᾿Υπείκω obsecundo. Fut. ὑπείξω. ex ὑπο & εἴκω cedo.
᾿Υπενδύκω ο οv occulte contrarius, Coloss.2.14. adversarius, Heb.10.27.

᾿Υπὲρ praepos. cum Genit. pro, Johan.6.51. propter, 2.Thess.1.5. supra, 1.Corinth.15.29. vice, Philem.v.13. nomine 2.Corinth.5.20. cum Accus. supra, 1.Cor.4.6. Comparationi inservit, Luc.16.8. Gal.1.14.
᾿Υπεραίρω supra modum me effero, me jactito. item, antecello. F. ὑπερἐξάρω. P. ὑπερῆρκα. a.1. act. ὑπερῆρξα. ὑπεραίρομαι supra modum effe-ror, vel effero me ipsum, 2.Thess.2.4.
᾿Υπέρακμος ὦ ὁ ἡ florem aetatis excedens. ex ὑπὲρ supra & ἀκμὴ ἧς ἡ proprie cuspis, item flos & vigor aetatis, 1.Cor.7.36.
᾿Υπερέχω cum Genit. Adv. longe supra. ex ὑπὲρ & ἄνω sursum.
᾿Υπεραυξάνω vehementer augesco. F. ὑπεραυξήσω. a.1. act. ὑπηύξησα.

page.notes: Left margin notes are cut off and largely illegible; not transcribed.
